parameter-group.name: advanced
parameter-group.label: Advanced
parameter-group.description: These configuration parameters allow you to alter advanced behaviour with writes.

parameter.name: address
parameter.label: Read Address
parameter.description:
Start address of the first holding register or coil in the write. Use empty for read-only things.
Use zero based address, e.g. in place of 400001 (first holding register), use the address 0. This address is passed to data frame as is.
One can write individual bits of a register using X.Y format where X is the register and Y is the bit (0 refers to least significant bit).

parameter.name: valueType
parameter.label: Write Value Type
parameter.description: Method to encode the number command to Modbus binary

options.option: 64bit positive or negative integer, 4 registers (int64, uint64)
64bit positive or negative integer, 4 registers but with 16bit words/registers in reverse order (dcba) (int64_swap, uint64_swap)
32bit positive or negative integer, 2 registers (int32, uint32)
32bit positive or negative integer, 2 registers but with 16bit words/registers in reverse order (ba) (int32_swap, uint32_swap)
16bit positive or negative integer, 1 register (int16, uint16)

parameter.name: minValue
parameter.label: Min value
parameter.description: Consider 0% representing this number when writing

parameter.name: maxValue
parameter.label: Max value
parameter.description: Consider 100% representing this number when writing

parameter.name: writeMultiple
parameter.label: Write using FC16 always
parameter.description:
Whether single register of data is written using FC16 ("Write Multiple Holding Registers").

If false, FC6 is used with single register. Some devices only accept FC16.

parameter.name: writeMaxTries
parameter.label: Maximum Tries When Writing
parameter.description: Number of tries when writing data, if some of the writes fail. For single try, enter 1.
